C.semantic_definition: constraint strain is pressure produced by contradiction within the measured window
unresolved: implicit contradiction semantics are not measured by the maintained proxy

R.semantic_definition: refusal density is the concentration of refusal relative to active constraint statements
unresolved: implemented denominator is token-count scale, not counted constraint statements

F.semantic_definition: fixation is persistence of substantially the same constraint bearing pattern across successive states
unresolved: maintained implementation is a lexical structural proxy, not embedding similarity

E.semantic_definition: escalation is positive change in commitment or constraint intensity across sequence
unresolved: maintained implementation does not directly compute commitment-intensity derivative

D.semantic_definition: deflection is movement away from the active constraint bearing subject or relation
unresolved: prior-round lexical overlap substitutes for active-constraint topic tracking

N.semantic_definition: noise is activity that consumes representational space without proportionate constraint resolution
unresolved: maintained implementation measures repetition and entropy rather than resolution ratio

I.semantic_definition: integration failure is failure of a correction or newly supplied constraint to alter subsequent behavior accordingly
unresolved: maintained implementation does not observe subsequent integration behavior

O.semantic_definition: O has conflicting maintained semantic names and therefore has no closed semantic origin yet
unresolved: marker canon says Overextension; compute.py says Overconfidence

L.semantic_definition: L has conflicting maintained semantic names and therefore has no closed semantic origin yet
unresolved: marker canon says Load; compute.py says Coherence Loss

P.semantic_definition: progress is newly integrated information or state change that advances resolution relative to the prior state
unresolved: progress is explicitly implemented as a proxy

kappa.semantic_definition: stored tension is unresolved dissonance carried forward as circuit state
unresolved: resolution function is currently approximated from dissonance
